items.name: Module
items.summary: Information about a module, notably its name, path, and contents.

methods.name: allows_top_level_await
methods.summary: Whether top-level `await`, `async for`, and `async with` are permitted in this module. True for Jupyter notebooks (`.ipynb`) and for shebang-based `.py` notebooks (files with a `--kernel <name>` shebang), since both runtimes evaluate top-l…

methods.name: display
methods.signature: fn display<'a>(&'a self, x: &'a impl DisplayWith<Module>) -> impl Display + 'a

methods.name: from_lsp_position
methods.signature: fn from_lsp_position(&self, position: lsp_types::Position, notebook_cell: Option<usize>) -> TextSize
methods.summary: Translates an LSP position to a text size. For notebooks, the input position is relative to a notebook cell and the output position is relative to the concatenated contents of the notebook.

methods.name: from_lsp_range
methods.signature: fn from_lsp_range(&self, position: lsp_types::Range, notebook_cell: Option<usize>) -> TextRange
methods.summary: Translates an LSP position to a text range. For notebooks, the input range is relative to a notebook cell and the output position is range to the concatenated contents of the notebook.

methods.signature: fn new(name: ModuleName, path: ModulePath, contents: Arc<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new Module. Will NOT read the `path`, but use the value from `contents` instead.
